rows.name: DICE_CANCEL_SIGKILL_SEC

cells.Set by: A person, in the environment of the Dice daemon.
cells.Values and default: Number of seconds, parsed with `float()`. Text that is not a number ends the daemon at startup with an error. Unset: 10 seconds. Empty: the daemon ends at startup with the error `DICE_CANCEL_SIGKILL_SEC must be a number`.
cells.Effect: Sets how long the Dice daemon waits before it sends `SIGKILL` to a canceled submission that is still running. The wait starts at the first cancel request. The daemon reads it once at startup. `0`, a negative number, `inf` or `nan` gives 10 seconds. When the LSF runner requests the cancel, or when the LSF runner process no longer exists, the wait is at most 2 seconds. The wait also applies when the first process of a submission exits and others remain.

bin/dice:3303-3309 - a bridge-cancel request of the LSF runner limits the wait to _BRIDGE_CANCEL_GRACE_SECONDS; force sends SIGKILL at once

rows.name: DICE_NUMA_SIZES

cells.Set by: A person, in the environment of the Dice daemon.
cells.Values and default: Positive integers separated by commas, one slot count per NUMA node in slot order, for example `4,4`. Parsed with `int`. The sum must equal the slot count of the server. Unset: the daemon derives the counts from `numa_nodes` in `config/resource-map.yaml`. If that fails, it treats the whole server as one NUMA node.
cells.Effect: Tells the Dice daemon how many slots each NUMA node has. The daemon first looks for free adjacent slots inside one NUMA node. It uses slots that cross NUMA nodes only when no such block is free. The daemon reads its own environment, once at startup. A value that does not parse, has a count below 1 slot, or has a wrong sum raises no error. The daemon then treats the whole server as one NUMA node and ignores `numa_nodes` of `config/resource-map.yaml`.

rows.name: DICE_LSF_LEASE_PID

cells.Read by: `dice` daemon (`bin/dice`). It reads the variable from the environment that a client sends with a submit request, not from its own environment.
cells.Values and default: Integer, parsed with `int()`. It is the process id of the LSF runner (`bin/dice-lsf-runner`). Unset: with `DICE_LSF_LEASE_START_JIFFIES` also unset, the submission has no runner lease. Empty: the daemon rejects the submit request.
cells.Effect: On a shared host the Dice daemon records the runner process as the owner of the submission. When that process no longer exists, the daemon cancels the submission. It sends `SIGTERM`, then `SIGKILL` after at most 2 seconds. When either lease variable is set, the daemon rejects the request unless both are integers and `DICE_LSF_RUNNING` is `1`. The pair must also match a live process of the same user, and the client must descend from that process. `DICE_LSF_RUNNING=1` without the two lease variables is also rejected.

rows.name: DICE_LSF_LEASE_START_JIFFIES

cells.Read by: `dice` daemon (`bin/dice`). It reads the variable from the environment that a client sends with a submit request, not from its own environment.
cells.Values and default: Integer, parsed with `int()`. It is the start time of the LSF runner process in clock ticks counted from boot, from field 22 of `/proc/<pid>/stat`. Unset: with `DICE_LSF_LEASE_PID` also unset, the submission has no runner lease. Empty: the daemon rejects the submit request.
cells.Effect: Together with `DICE_LSF_LEASE_PID` it identifies the LSF runner process that owns the submission. The Dice daemon compares it with the start time of that process id. A different start time counts as a lost lease, and the daemon cancels the submission. The daemon rejects a request with only one lease variable, with text that is not an integer, or without `DICE_LSF_RUNNING=1`. A value of 0 clock ticks or less never matches a live process.

Rows over the limit before the change: DICE_DAEMON_CHILD (1,084 characters), DICE_GRANT_ID (1,047), DICE_SLOTS (1,225) and DICE_LSF_LEASE_START_JIFFIES (1,006). All 12 rows are now at or under 1,000 characters.
